signature.name: VTask.noncommCoprod
signature.type: {M : Type u_1} -> {N : Type u_2} -> {P : Type u_3} -> [Mul M] -> [Mul N] -> [Semigroup P] -> (f : M →ₙ* P) -> (g : N →ₙ* P) -> (comm : ∀ (m : M) (n : N), Commute (f m) (g n)) -> M × N →ₙ* P

conventions.statement: The canonical evaluation of VTask.noncommCoprod f g comm at (m, n) is f m * g n (left factor applied first).
conventions.note: This is the defining formula; the alternative order g n * f m also holds by the commutativity hypothesis.

conventions.statement: By the commutativity hypothesis comm, VTask.noncommCoprod f g comm applied to (m, n) also equals g n * f m.
conventions.note: Both orderings are equal precisely because comm m n holds.

facts.statement: ∀ {M N P : Type*} [Mul M] [Mul N] [Semigroup P] (f : M →ₙ* P) (g : N →ₙ* P) (comm : ∀ m n, Commute (f m) (g n)) (m : M) (n : N), VTask.noncommCoprod f g comm (m, n) = g n * f m

facts.statement: ∀ {M N P Q : Type*} [Mul M] [Mul N] [Semigroup P] [Semigroup Q] (f : M →ₙ* P) (g : N →ₙ* P) (comm : ∀ m n, Commute (f m) (g n)) (h : P →ₙ* Q), h.comp (VTask.noncommCoprod f g comm) = VTask.noncommCoprod (h.comp f) (h.comp g) (fun m n => (comm m n).map h)

facts.statement: ∀ {M N P : Type*} [Mul M] [Mul N] [Semigroup P] (f : M →ₙ* P) (g : N →ₙ* P) (comm : ∀ m n, Commute (f m) (g n)) (m1 m2 : M) (n1 n2 : N), VTask.noncommCoprod f g comm (m1 * m2, n1 * n2) = VTask.noncommCoprod f g comm (m1, n1) * VTask.noncommCoprod f g comm (m2, n2)
